title: Complete `shutdown.rs` — graceful PromptHub shutdown
resolution: Completed the graceful-shutdown feature and wired it into a real shutdown path (no downgrades; nothing removed/stubbed; #![forbid(unsafe_code)] preserved). shutdown.rs: ShutdownCoordinator now tracks an Arc<AtomicBool> shutdown state so shutdown() is idempotent and observable (is_shutting_down/subscriber_count added, Clone shares state); wait_for_signal() rewritten to return Result<(), HubError> instead of panicking on signal-handler install failure (SIGTERM/SIGINT on unix, ctrl_c fallback elsewhere); graceful_shutdown() now polls subscribers to drain within a timeout and returns HubError-native Result. hub.rs: added a shared shutdown_coordinator field + shutdown_coordinator()/is_shutting_down() accessors; PromptHub::shutdown() upgraded from storage-flush-only to an orderly sequence — broadcast signal -> stop auto-purge daemon (feature-gated, best-effort) -> stop chaos-automation scheduler (feature-gated) -> flush WAL via optimize_on_close. prompthub-server/src/main.rs: removed the duplicate panicking shutdown_signal() and wired the server's with_graceful_shutdown to the hub's coordinator (subscribe + wait_for_signal), then calls hub.shutdown() after serve returns — so the coordinator is genuinely reachable from the server and shares one rendezvous with the hub daemons. Tests: 6 new ShutdownCoordinator unit tests (idempotency, state transitions, clones share state, signaling completes a waiting subscriber, graceful drain + timeout tolerance) and 3 hub tests on a :memory: hub (shutdown runs cleanly + broadcasts, idempotent double-shutdown, coordinator shared) — `cargo test -p prompt-hub --all-features shutdown` = 11 passed. Gates green in BOTH configs: cargo build -p prompt-hub (default); cargo clippy -p prompt-hub --all-features --all-targets -D warnings (clean); cargo clippy -p prompt-hub --all-targets -D warnings (clean); cargo fmt --all --check (clean); cargo build --workspace --all-features (clean).
objective: INCOMPLETE FEATURE (not dead code): shutdown.rs (119 lines) has a ShutdownCoordinator whose wait_for_signal() is unfinished and which is never driven. COMPLETE it: finish wait_for_signal() (SIGINT/SIGTERM handling) and wire the coordinator into a real PromptHub::shutdown() that drains in-flight work, flushes storage/metrics, and stops background daemons (auto-purge, chaos-automation schedulers) cleanly. Upgrade only — finish graceful shutdown; do not gate it out.
acceptance_criteria: PromptHub::shutdown() drives ShutdownCoordinator to a clean stop (drain + flush)
a test exercises the shutdown flow
policy_note: Owner directive 2026-06-13: NO DOWNGRADES. A module that looks like dead code / an old feature is an INCOMPLETE feature to be completed — never removed or gated out. Upgrade only.
